background: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group is one of Japan's three megabanks, the holding company of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, SMBC Nikko Securities and a consumer finance arm, with growing operations in the United States and Asia.
synthesis: Ratings are A- from Fitch, A- from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable, with the last move Fitch's downgrade to A- on 8 Dec 2022. Capital is on the weak side of Asian peers: CET1 of 12.4% and leverage of 5.0% are both in the bottom quarter. No liquidity ratios are held here, and no trend can be drawn from the periods held. The flagged news is good, led by higher capital and leverage ratios reported on 14 Aug 2026 and first-quarter profit up on loan demand; size and earnings, rather than ratio headroom, are the comfort.
